entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey, how's school?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You're not causing any trouble, are you?
I'm not.
I might be.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Good.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Look here...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What're you all quiet for?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I've gotta report to your[n]probation officer twice a month.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: It's already a pain in the ass[n]as is, so please don't make me[n]have to write even more crap.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Got that? This society is kept in[n]check by laws and authority figures.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You can go and get yourself killed[n]if you want, but don't go dragging[n]other people into your mess.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: The last thing we need is more[n]idiots like you roaming around.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What's wrong?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Yeah, I'm heading out[n]now. Sorry about that.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...I know. The usual, right?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Okay. I'll see you later.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: As you can see, I'm pretty damn busy[n]both at work and in my private life.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: If you could lend a hand, it'd[n]really be a great help...
I'd be glad to.
I'm kinda busy...
It's too much trouble.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Now we're talking.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: So says the free-wheeling[n]high school student.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Sure, and watching after you[n]is just a walk in the park.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Either way, I won't ask you to work for[n]free. If you agree to help me, then...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I'll teach you how to make the perfect[n]cup of coffee. Not a bad trade, eh?
I guess.
Sounds interesting.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: All right. Looks like we've[n]got ourselves a deal.
The distance between me and Sojiro[n]seems to be closing slightly...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: You may call yourself a phantom[n]thief, but you're still a minor.[n]Someone had to support you.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Furthermore, they did so knowing[n]you were a part of that group...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...Isn't the owner of that café[n]an accomplice of yours!?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: You have agreed to a new[n]contract. Excellent.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Use this new bond to strengthen[n]your circle of support.
entries.uk: Використайте цей новий зв'язок,[n]щоб зміцнити своє коло підтримки.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...Okay then.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I'll be counting on your help.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: See ya later.
